blocks.text: when, as soon as, until ... dan keyin will emas

Qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 98–99-darslar) asosiy qoidani ko'rgansiz: I'll call you when I **get** home — when dan keyin kelajak ma'nosida ham **Present Simple**, will emas. Bu darsda qoidani kengaytiramiz: u qaysi bog'lovchilarga tegishli, qachon Present Perfect kerak, if va when qanday farqlanadi va will baribir qayerda ishlatiladi. Mantiq oddiy: asosiy gapdagi will kelajakni allaqachon bildirib turibdi, ergash gap esa faqat **vaqtni yoki shartni** belgilaydi. Qizig'i, o'zbekchada ham xuddi shunday: «uyga **kelganimda**», «**kelgach**», «**kelguncha**» — bu shakllarda kelasi zamon qo'shimchasi yo'q. Xato faqat «kelajak = will» degan yodlangan qoidadan chiqadi.

items.text: **As soon as** I **hear** from the bank, I'll let you know.
We'll stay at Grandma's **until** our flat **is** ready.
**Before** you **buy** a used car, ask a mechanic to check it.
items.translation: Ishlatilgan mashina **olishdan oldin**, uni ustaga tekshirtiring.

blocks.text: when I've done: avval biri tugashi kerak bo'lsa

Ergash gapdagi harakat asosiy harakatdan **oldin tugashi** kerak bo'lsa, Present Perfect ishlatiladi: When I**'ve read** this report, I'll give it to you — avval o'qib **bo'laman**, keyin beraman. O'zbekchada «-ib bo'lgach», «-ib bo'lganimdan keyin». Ikki harakat **bir vaqtda** bo'lsa yoki ketma-ketlik muhim bo'lmasa — Present Simple: When I **see** Tom, I'll tell him (ko'rgan zahotim aytaman). after, as soon as, once, until bilan ko'pincha ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: after I **finish** / after I**'ve finished** — farq kichik, Perfect tugallanganlikni ta'kidlaydi.

rows: When I **see** Aziz, I'll give him the keys.
When I**'ve repaired** the bike, I'll give it back.
I'll phone you when I**'ve unpacked**.
Don't go out until you**'ve finished** your homework.

items.text: **When** I**'ve paid** the bills, I'll see how much money is left.
items.translation: Kommunal to'lovlarni **to'lab bo'lgach**, qancha pul qolganini ko'raman.

items.text: You can go out **after** you**'ve tidied** your room.
I'll lend you this novel **as soon as** I**'ve finished** it.
items.translation: Bu romanni **o'qib bo'lishim bilan** senga beraman.

blocks.text: if va when: ehtimol yoki aniq

**when** — voqea **albatta** bo'lishiga ishonamiz, faqat vaqti haqida gapiramiz. **if** — voqea **bo'lishi ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin**. When I **get** home — uyga albatta boraman; If I **get** the job — ishni olishim noaniq. O'zbekchada «-sa» ikkala ma'noda ham keladi: «Uyga borsam, qo'ng'iroq qilaman» (aniq) — bu **when**; «Ishni olsam, ko'chamiz» (noaniq) — bu **if**. Shuning uchun «-sa» ni avtomatik if deb tarjima qilmang: avval «bu albatta bo'ladimi?» deb so'rang.

rows: When I **finish** university, I'll look for a job.
If I **fail** the exam, I'll take it again in June.
When the meeting **ends**, we'll go for lunch.
If the meeting **ends** early, we'll go for lunch.
I'll wake you up when it**'s** time.

items.text: **If** you **don't** hurry, you'll miss the bus.
**When** Bekzod **comes** back from the army, we'll have a big party.
**If** anyone **calls**, tell them I'm in a meeting.
items.translation: Agar kimdir qo'ng'iroq **qilsa**, yig'ilishdaman, deb ayt.

blocks.text: Qoida faqat **vaqt va shart** ergash gaplariga tegishli. Agar when — **so'roq so'zi** («qachon») bo'lsa yoki if = **whether** («...-mi, yo'qmi») bo'lsa, will odatdagidek ishlatiladi. Tell me when you **arrive** — Yetib **kelganingda** ayt; Tell me when you**'ll arrive** — **Qachon** yetib kelishingni ayt. I don't know if she**'ll come** — U **kelarmikan**, bilmayman. Yana bir nozik joy: kelajak haqidagi aniqlovchi ergash gapda va whoever, wherever, whatever dan keyin ham Present ishlatiladi: The person who **wins** will get a prize.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «When I will come home, I'll call you» → When I **come** home; «I'll wait until you will finish» → until you **finish** / **have finished**; «As soon as I will know...» → as soon as I **know**; «If it will rain...» → If it **rains**; teskari xato: «I don't know when he comes back» (qachon qaytishini bilmayman) → when he**'ll come** back; «-sa» ni doim if deb tarjima qilish: «Uyga borsam, qo'ng'iroq qilaman» → **When** I get home, I'll call you.

Tekshirish usuli: when / if / until ... qismini o'zbekchaga tarjima qilib ko'ring. «-ganda, -gach, -guncha, -sa» chiqsa — Present, will yo'q. «qachon ...-ishini», «...-armikan», «-mi, yo'qmi» chiqsa — will bo'lishi mumkin.

rows: Vaqt ergash gapi (when, until, as soon as...)
I don't know when she**'ll arrive**.

examples.title: **when** + present, not **will**
examples.description: Kelajak ma'nosida bo'lsa ham when dan keyin Present Simple; will faqat asosiy gapda. O'zbekchada «-ganda».

sentences.text: **When** I **get** to the hotel, I'll send you a photo of the view.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga **yetib borganimda**, sizga manzaradan surat yuboraman.

sentences.text: Aziz will be really surprised **when** he **sees** his new office.
sentences.translation: Aziz yangi ofisini **ko'rganida** juda hayron bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **When** you **visit** Khiva, don't miss the old city walls at sunset.
sentences.translation: Xivaga **borganingizda**, quyosh botayotgandagi qadimiy shahar devorlarini ko'rmay qolmang.

sentences.text: Give me a ring **when** you**'re** ready to leave, and I'll pick you up.
sentences.translation: Chiqishga **tayyor bo'lganingda** qo'ng'iroq qil, seni olib ketaman.

sentences.text: What will you do **when** you **retire**, Mr Davies?
sentences.translation: Nafaqaga **chiqqaningizda** nima qilasiz, janob Devis?

sentences.text: **When** the rain **stops**, we'll go for a walk along the river.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **to'xtaganida** daryo bo'ylab sayr qilgani chiqamiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza will be twenty-five **when** she **finishes** her PhD.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza doktorlikni **tugatganida** yigirma besh yoshda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I'll tell you everything **when** we **meet** — it's too complicated for a text.
sentences.translation: **Uchrashganimizda** hammasini aytib beraman — xabarda yozish uchun juda murakkab.

sentences.text: We'll buy a new fridge **when** prices **go** down after the holidays.
sentences.translation: Bayramlardan keyin narxlar **tushganda** yangi muzlatgich olamiz.

sentences.text: Don't forget to lock the door **when** you **leave** the flat tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: Ertaga ertalab kvartiradan **chiqqaningda** eshikni qulflashni unutma.

examples.title: **as soon as**, **before**, **after**, **until**, **while**
examples.description: Boshqa vaqt bog'lovchilari ham xuddi when kabi: kelajak ma'nosida ulardan keyin Present Simple.

sentences.text: I'll text you **as soon as** the plane **lands** in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Samolyot Manchesterga **qo'nishi bilan** senga xabar yozaman.

sentences.text: Please switch off all the lights **before** you **leave** the office tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun ofisdan **ketishdan oldin**, iltimos, hamma chiroqlarni o'chiring.

sentences.text: We'll wait here **until** the doctor **comes** out of the operating theatre.
sentences.translation: Shifokor operatsiya xonasidan **chiqquncha** shu yerda kutamiz.

sentences.text: **After** Madina **finishes** her exams, she's going to spend a month in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Madina imtihonlarini **tugatgandan keyin** bir oyni Farg'onada o'tkazmoqchi.

sentences.text: **While** you**'re** in London, try to see a show in the West End.
sentences.translation: Londonda **bo'lganingda**, West Endda biror spektaklni ko'rishga harakat qil.

sentences.text: Don't sign anything **until** a lawyer **checks** the contract.
sentences.translation: Advokat shartnomani **tekshirmaguncha** hech narsaga imzo chekma.

sentences.text: **Once** the new road **opens**, the journey to Samarkand will take only three hours.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l **ochilgach**, Samarqandga yo'l atigi uch soat oladi.

sentences.text: **By the time** we **arrive**, the concert will have finished.
sentences.translation: Biz **yetib borgunimizcha** konsert tugagan bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Next time** you **come** to Bukhara, you must stay with us.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga **keyingi safar kelganingda**, albatta biznikida qolishing kerak.

sentences.text: I'm going to stay in Tashkent **until** I **find** a well-paid job.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi maoshli ish **topmagunimcha** Toshkentda qolaman.

examples.title: Finished first: **when I've done**
examples.description: Ergash gapdagi harakat avval tugashi kerak — Present Perfect. O'zbekchada «-ib bo'lgach», «-ib bo'lganimdan keyin».

sentences.text: **When** I**'ve paid** off the loan, I'll finally buy a new car.
sentences.translation: Kreditni **to'lab bo'lganimdan keyin** nihoyat yangi mashina olaman.

sentences.text: You can borrow my notes **as soon as** I**'ve typed** them up.
sentences.translation: Konspektlarimni kompyuterga **ko'chirib bo'lishim bilan** olib tursang bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Don't sign the contract **until** you**'ve read** every page carefully.
sentences.translation: Har bir sahifani diqqat bilan **o'qib chiqmaguningcha** shartnomaga imzo chekma.

sentences.text: **After** the guests **have left**, we'll clean the kitchen together.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **ketgandan keyin** oshxonani birga tozalaymiz.

sentences.text: Jasur says he'll call you **when** he**'s spoken** to his manager.
sentences.translation: Jasur menejeri bilan **gaplashib bo'lgach**, sizga qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytyapti.

sentences.text: **Once** you**'ve tried** Samarkand bread, you won't want any other kind.
sentences.translation: Samarqand nonini bir **tatib ko'rganingizdan keyin**, boshqasini xohlamaysiz.

sentences.text: I'm not going to watch the series **until** I**'ve finished** the book it's based on.
sentences.translation: Serial asoslangan kitobni **o'qib tugatmagunimcha** uni ko'rmayman.

sentences.text: **When** you**'ve had** a rest, we can talk about what happened at work.
sentences.translation: Biroz **dam olganingdan keyin**, ishda nima bo'lgani haqida gaplashamiz.

sentences.text: Let me know **as soon as** you**'ve booked** the tickets, so I can ask for leave.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni **band qilishing bilan** menga xabar ber, men ta'tilga ariza beraman.

sentences.text: The doctor will discharge you **after** she**'s seen** the results of your scan.
sentences.translation: Shifokor tekshiruv natijalarini **ko'rib chiqqandan keyin** sizni uyga javob beradi.

examples.title: **when I see** or **when I've seen**?
examples.description: Juft-juft: ikki harakat bir vaqtda (Present Simple) yoki biri avval tugaydi (Present Perfect).

sentences.text: **When** I **see** Bekzod tomorrow, I'll tell him about the party.
sentences.translation: Ertaga Bekzodni **ko'rganimda** unga ziyofat haqida aytaman.

sentences.text: **When** I**'ve seen** the film, I'll tell you if it's worth watching.
sentences.translation: Filmni **ko'rib bo'lgach**, ko'rishga arziydimi-yo'qmi, aytaman.

sentences.text: Turn off the oven **when** the timer **rings**, please.
sentences.translation: Taymer **jiringlaganda**, iltimos, pechni o'chir.

sentences.text: You can take the cake out of the tin **when** it**'s cooled** down a bit.
sentences.translation: Tort biroz **sovigandan keyin** uni qolipdan olsang bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **As soon as** the doors **open**, people will rush in for the sale.
sentences.translation: Eshiklar **ochilishi bilan** odamlar chegirma uchun ichkariga yopiriladi.

sentences.text: **As soon as** I**'ve done** the shopping, I'll come back and help you.
sentences.translation: Xaridni **qilib bo'lishim bilan** qaytib kelib, senga yordam beraman.

sentences.text: We'll have dinner **when** Dad **comes** home from work.
sentences.translation: Dadam ishdan **kelganida** kechki ovqat qilamiz.

sentences.text: We'll serve dessert **when** everyone **has finished** the main course.
sentences.translation: Hamma asosiy taomni **yeb bo'lgach**, shirinlik tortamiz.

sentences.text: **After** I **leave** school, I want to work abroad for a year.
sentences.translation: Maktabni **bitirgandan keyin** bir yil chet elda ishlamoqchiman.

sentences.text: **After** I**'ve saved** enough money, I want to travel around Asia.
sentences.translation: Yetarlicha pul **yig'ib olganimdan keyin** Osiyo bo'ylab sayohat qilmoqchiman.

examples.title: **if** or **when**? Possible or certain
examples.description: when — voqea albatta bo'ladi; if — bo'lishi noaniq. Ikkalasidan keyin ham Present.

sentences.text: **When** I **get** home tonight, I'll have a long hot bath.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uyga **borganimda** uzoq iliq vanna qabul qilaman.

sentences.text: **If** I **get** the job in Edinburgh, we'll have to move.
sentences.translation: Agar Edinburgdagi ishni **olsam**, ko'chishimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: Call me **when** your train **leaves** Samarkand, so I know when to meet you.
sentences.translation: Poyezding Samarqanddan **jo'naganda** qo'ng'iroq qil, seni qachon kutib olishni bilaman.

sentences.text: Call me **if** your train **is** late, and I'll wait in the café.
sentences.translation: Agar poyezding **kechiksa**, qo'ng'iroq qil, kafeda kutib turaman.

sentences.text: **If** it **rains** on Saturday, we'll have the picnic indoors.
sentences.translation: Agar shanba kuni yomg'ir **yog'sa**, piknikni ichkarida o'tkazamiz.

sentences.text: I'll wake you up **when** it**'s** time to go to the airport.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga ketish vaqti **bo'lganda** seni uyg'otaman.

sentences.text: **If** Oliver **doesn't** call back by five, I'll email his assistant.
sentences.translation: Agar Oliver beshgacha qayta qo'ng'iroq **qilmasa**, yordamchisiga xat yozaman.

sentences.text: **When** the baby **is** born, Nilufar's mother will come and stay for a month.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **tug'ilganda** Nilufarning onasi kelib bir oy qolib turadi.

sentences.text: Grandma will be so happy **if** you **visit** her this weekend.
sentences.translation: Agar shu dam olish kunlari buvingning oldiga **borsang**, u juda xursand bo'ladi.

sentences.text: We'll celebrate **when** the project **is** over, and **if** it **succeeds**, we'll celebrate twice!
sentences.translation: Loyiha **tugaganda** nishonlaymiz, agar u **muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa**, ikki marta nishonlaymiz!

examples.title: Exception: **when** = «qachon», **if** = «-mi»
examples.description: when so'roq so'zi bo'lsa yoki if = whether bo'lsa, will odatdagidek ishlatiladi. Bir xil gapda ikki xil when.

sentences.text: Do you know **when** the results **will be** ready?
sentences.translation: Natijalar qachon tayyor **bo'lishini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: I'm not sure **if** Madina **will come** to the party tonight.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun kechqurun ziyofatga **kelarmikan**, aniq bilmayman.

sentences.text: **When will** the new metro station **open**? — Nobody knows yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro bekati qachon **ochiladi**? — Hali hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Tell me **when** you **arrive**, and I'll come down to the lobby.
sentences.translation: **Yetib kelganingda** ayt, men pastga, qabulxonaga tushaman.

sentences.text: Tell me **when** you**'ll arrive**, so I can book a taxi for the right time.
sentences.translation: Qachon **yetib kelishingni** ayt, taksini to'g'ri vaqtga buyurtma qilaman.

sentences.text: Kate wonders **whether** her parents **will like** her new boyfriend.
sentences.translation: Keyt yangi yigiti ota-onasiga **yoqarmikan**, deb o'ylayapti.

sentences.text: Nobody can say **if** the new law **will** really **help** small businesses.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun kichik bizneslarga haqiqatan **yordam berarmikan** — buni hech kim ayta olmaydi.

sentences.text: The forecast can't say **if** it **will rain** tomorrow, so we'll take umbrellas anyway.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumoti ertaga yomg'ir **yog'adimi-yo'qmi** ayta olmaydi, shuning uchun baribir soyabon olamiz.

sentences.text: I have no idea **when** I**'ll see** Sarah again, because she's moving to Australia.
sentences.translation: Sarani yana qachon **ko'rishimni** bilmayman, chunki u Avstraliyaga ko'chib ketyapti.

sentences.text: **When** you **see** Sarah, ask her **when** she**'ll be** back.
sentences.translation: Sarani **ko'rganingda**, undan qachon **qaytishini** so'ra.

examples.title: Dialogue: before a business trip
examples.description: Aziz Manchesterga xizmat safariga ketyapti; rafiqasi bilan suhbatda when, after, as soon as, until, if dan keyin Present.

sentences.text: — **When** you **get** to Manchester, call me straight away, OK?
sentences.translation: — Manchesterga **yetib borganingda** darhol qo'ng'iroq qil, xo'pmi?

sentences.text: — I will, but only **after** I**'ve checked** into the hotel.
sentences.translation: — Qo'ng'iroq qilaman, lekin mehmonxonaga **joylashib olganimdan keyin**.

sentences.text: — And **if** the flight **is** delayed, send me a message.
sentences.translation: — Agar reys **kechiksa**, menga xabar yubor.

sentences.text: — Of course. I'll message you **as soon as** I **know** anything.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Biror narsa **bilishim bilan** senga yozaman.

sentences.text: — What will you do **while** you**'re** waiting for the meeting?
sentences.translation: — Uchrashuvni **kutayotganingda** nima qilasan?

sentences.text: — I'll work on my slides **until** the client **arrives**, I suppose.
sentences.translation: — Mijoz **kelguncha** slaydlarim ustida ishlayman, shekilli.

sentences.text: — Don't forget to eat something **before** you **go** into the meeting.
sentences.translation: — Uchrashuvga **kirishdan oldin** biror narsa yeyishni unutma.

sentences.text: — I won't. And **when** I**'ve signed** the contract, I'll buy you a present!
sentences.translation: — Unutmayman. Shartnomani **imzolab bo'lgach**, senga sovg'a olaman!

sentences.text: — Only **if** they **agree** to your price, remember.
sentences.translation: — Faqat ular narxingga **rozi bo'lsa**, esingda bo'lsin.

sentences.text: — They will. I'll call you **the moment** they **sign**!
sentences.translation: — Rozi bo'lishadi. Ular **imzo chekishi bilan** senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman!

examples.title: Mixed: plans, promises and conditions
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: vaqt va shart ergash gaplari, who / whoever / wherever dan keyin Present va «qachon?» ma'nosidagi when + will.

sentences.text: **Once** the visa **arrives**, Bekzod will book his flight to London.
sentences.translation: Viza **kelgach**, Bekzod Londonga chipta band qiladi.

sentences.text: You won't recognise the city centre **when** they**'ve finished** all the building work.
sentences.translation: Barcha qurilish ishlarini **tugatishgach**, shahar markazini tanimay qolasiz.

sentences.text: Whoever **wins** the election will face serious economic problems.
sentences.translation: Saylovda kim **g'alaba qozonsa** ham, jiddiy iqtisodiy muammolarga duch keladi.

sentences.text: **Before** you **make** a decision, talk to someone who has worked there.
sentences.translation: Qaror **qabul qilishdan oldin**, u yerda ishlagan biror kishi bilan gaplashib ko'r.

sentences.text: The company will give a bonus to every employee who **reaches** the sales target.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya savdo rejasini **bajargan** har bir xodimga mukofot beradi.

sentences.text: I'll lend you my camera, but only **if** you **promise** to be careful with it.
sentences.translation: Fotoapparatimni beraman, faqat ehtiyot bo'lishga **va'da bersang**.

sentences.text: Nobody knows **when** the bridge **will reopen**, so drivers should use the ring road.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik qachon qayta **ochilishini** hech kim bilmaydi, shuning uchun haydovchilar halqa yo'ldan foydalanishi kerak.

sentences.text: **By the time** Emma **gets** her driving licence, she'll have taken over forty lessons.
sentences.translation: Emma haydovchilik guvohnomasini **olguncha** qirqdan ortiq dars olgan bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Wherever you **go** in Uzbekistan, people will invite you in for tea.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonning qayeriga **borsangiz** ham, odamlar sizni choyga taklif qiladi.

sentences.text: Let's not make any decisions **until** we**'ve heard** what the director thinks.
sentences.translation: Direktor nima deb o'ylashini **eshitmagunimizcha** hech qanday qaror qabul qilmaylik.
